messages.subject: Building shiny-server on arch linux (64-bit)
parts:
Hey everyone,

I'm trying to get shiny-server to build, and it keeps failing with the following error: http://ix.io/9NO

I've tried both following the build instructions line-by-line, and by using the following pkgbuild (build script): http://ix.io/9NJ

If I can get it to build, I can upload it to the arch user repo for others to use. The only difference really in the pkgbuild is that it executes several sed replacement commands to replace instances of python to python2, where appropriate. These commands were taken from the arch pkgbuild for nodejs.

If anyone can help me out, I'd greatly appreciate it.

messages.author: f769d7d2cfcf4edc
messages.subject: Re: Building shiny-server on arch linux (64-bit)
parts:
I just tried building it by linking /usr/local/bin/python to `which python2`, and it worked.
This implies to me that setting the configure option and environ variable to `which python2` does not work.

I cannot make a pkgbuild that first installs a link to python2; what do you recommend? Should I set the PATH to ../bin, and put a link to python2 in there?
